answer: Work waits on the beacon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the bridge of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the crystal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
